description: How the Check-In Station prints name tags: which printer path to use, the label size, and whether tags carry a pickup code and the person's allergies.

fields.description:
Browser: opens the browser's print dialog (any printer with a driver).
Zebra Browser Print: silent ZPL printing through Zebra's free Browser Print app installed on the station computer.
QZ Tray: silent ZPL printing through the QZ Tray app installed on the station computer.
Network Printer: the server sends ZPL straight to a Zebra printer on the church network.
fields.label: Name Tag Printing
fields.options:

QZ Tray

fields.description: IP address or hostname of the Zebra printer (see the printer's network configuration label).
fields.label: Printer Host

fields.description: Printer name as listed by QZ Tray. Leave blank to use the computer's default printer.
fields.label: Printer Name

fields.description: Label width in inches. Common name tag labels are 4 x 2 in (Zebra) and 2.25 x 1.25 in (Dymo).
fields.label: Label Width (in)

fields.description: Print resolution of the Zebra printer. The ZD421 ships as 203 or 300 dpi.
fields.label: Printer DPI

fields.description: Print a random pickup code on every name tag, and one extra pickup tag per family listing the names and code. Used to match children with the adult collecting them.
fields.label: Print Security Codes

fields.description: Print the person's allergies under their name, from the Allergies field on the Person. Tags for people with no allergies stay as they are.
fields.label: Print Allergies on Name Tags

fields.description: Print Format used for Browser printing. Duplicate the standard Name Tag format to customize it.
fields.label: Name Tag Format

fields.description: Raw ZPL Print Format used for Zebra printing. Duplicate the standard Zebra Name Tag format to customize it.
fields.label: ZPL Format

fields.description: A different name tag for Guest or Volunteer check-ins. A kind with no row uses the formats above.
fields.label: Tag Formats by Kind

fields.description: What check-in does when the rooms booked for a Function are full. Capacity is the sum of the Capacity of each Room in the Function's approved Room Bookings. Off: no check. Warn: the station shows a warning. Block: check-in is refused.
fields.label: Room Capacity

fields.description: How many minutes before a Function starts the self check-in kiosk and pre check-in codes accept it. They stop when the Function ends.
fields.label: Self Check-In Opens (Minutes Before Start)

fields.description: Add a row for a church whose station prints somewhere else. Fields left blank in a row use the settings above.
fields.label: Printers Per Church

name: Check-In Settings
